meta.note: Price is recorded for the reverse DCF and the final comparison only; every intrinsic input below is set from filings, history, guidance-confidence scores and peer data.

claims.sources: 10-Q Q2-2026 balance sheet & liquidity; 10-K 2025 pension note (US +77, non-US -215, OPEB -231) and asbestos note (gross 107 less receivable 57). Op. leases stay in opex in the DCF (not added as debt); factoring cost is deducted in FCFF instead of adding factored receivables as debt.

wacc.rationale: rf = 10y UST 5.18% (2026-09-25). ERP 4.5%. Asset beta 1.0 = tire-peer range 0.9-1.15 (GT's own 2y/3y/5y weekly betas 0.57/0.85/1.38 too noisy, corr<0.45). Expected return on B+/BB- debt = rf + 0.5*ERP = 7.45% (promised ~8.75-8.9% incl. expected default loss). Tax shield only 10% because US and Luxembourg DTAs carry full valuation allowances.

common.financing_fees_note: Cash cost of receivable factoring/securitization (~$35m of the ~$60m guided financing fees; the rest is revolver commitment fees and non-cash issuance-cost amortization, treated as cost of debt).

bull.narrative: Management plan largely delivered: Fayetteville/EMEA savings ~90% retained, replacement volumes recover, pricing holds; SOI margin 8% (still below the retired 10% target and peer ~11%).

base.narrative: Recovery to the 2021-2025 average SOI margin (~6%): unabsorbed overhead reverses, footprint savings ~50% net of inflation, continued share loss at the low end. Growth adds no value (RONIC = WACC).

bear.narrative: Low-cost imports keep taking share, savings consumed by inflation (as in 2024-25), EMEA stays near break-even; margins stuck near the 2023-2026 average (~4%).

distress.narrative: Bear operations plus a refinancing/liquidity event (8.875% marginal cost of debt, leverage >5x): debt-for-equity exchange or deeply dilutive rescue equity; legacy shareholders keep a residual option only.

probability_rationale: Anchored on (i) GT's own margin record: SOI margin >=8% in 0 of the last 7 years, 6-8% in 4, <6% in 3 (plus H1-26 at 1.6%); (ii) medium-term margin-target confidence score 0/100 -> management-style outcome confined to a 15% bull case; (iii) B+/B1 ratings, negative 2026 FCF and 3.8x LTM leverage vs 5-year cumulative default rates of roughly 10-15% for single-B+ issuers -> 12% distress. Judgment is used for the 45/28 split between base and bear.

comps.gt_hist_ev_ebitda_note: Median of GT year-end EV/adj. EBITDA 2022-2025 (4.66, 6.19, 4.35, 4.17); 2015-2025 median 5.25x reflects a lower-rate, higher-margin era.

cooper_2021.note: EV ~$2.5bn (equity $2.8bn at $54.36/sh less net cash ~$0.3bn) / 2020 EBITDA $390m (op. income 231 + D&A 159, SEC XBRL)

otr_2025.note: $905m / est. EBITDA ~$125m (analyst estimate; segment disclosure only)

residual_income.terminal_fade: Ohlson-style: residual income after 2035 persists with factor 0.9 per year
